From 5427290d64c752b97d6a2af7506771c7d10eb750 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Kinglong Mee <kinglongmee@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Mar 2017 17:22:43 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] SUNRPC/backchanel: set XPT_CONG_CTRL flag for bc xprt

The xprt for backchannel is created separately, not in TCP/UDP code.  It
needs the XPT_CONG_CTRL flag set on it too--otherwise requests on the
NFSv4.1 backchannel are rjected in svc_process_common():

1191         if (versp->vs_need_cong_ctrl &&
1192             !test_bit(XPT_CONG_CTRL, &rqstp->rq_xprt->xpt_flags))
1193                 goto err_bad_vers;

Fixes: 5283b03ee5 ("nfs/nfsd/sunrpc: enforce transport...")
Signed-off-by: Kinglong Mee <kinglongmee@gmail.com>
Reviewed-by: Jeff Layton <jlayton@redhat.com>
Signed-off-by: J. Bruce Fields <bfields@redhat.com>

diff --git a/net/sunrpc/svcsock.c b/net/sunrpc/svcsock.c
index 8931e33b6541..2b720fa35c4f 100644
--- a/net/sunrpc/svcsock.c
+++ b/net/sunrpc/svcsock.c
@@ -1635,6 +1635,7 @@ static struct svc_xprt *svc_bc_create_socket(struct svc_serv *serv,
 
 	xprt = &svsk->sk_xprt;
 	svc_xprt_init(net, &svc_tcp_bc_class, xprt, serv);
+	set_bit(XPT_CONG_CTRL, &svsk->sk_xprt.xpt_flags);
 
 	serv->sv_bc_xprt = xprt;
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `net/sunrpc/svcsock.c`**
   - A new line of code was added to set the `XPT_CONG_CTRL` flag for the backchannel transport (`xprt`). Specifically, the line `set_bit(XPT_CONG_CTRL, &svsk->sk_xprt.xpt_flags);` was inserted after the initialization of the transport in the `svc_bc_create_socket` function.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `net/sunrpc/svcsock.c` addresses a bug related to the handling of requests on the NFSv4.1 backchannel. By setting the `XPT_CONG_CTRL` flag, the patch ensures that the backchannel transport is properly configured to handle congestion control, which is necessary for the correct functioning of the service. This change is directly related to the issue described in the `svc_process_common()` function, where requests were being rejected if the congestion control flag was not set. The patch fixes this by ensuring that the flag is set during the creation of the backchannel transport.

Here is the commit message:
SUNRPC/backchanel: set XPT_CONG_CTRL flag for bc xprt

The xprt for backchannel is created separately, not in TCP/UDP code.  It
needs the XPT_CONG_CTRL flag set on it too--otherwise requests on the
NFSv4.1 backchannel are rjected in svc_process_common():

1191         if (versp->vs_need_cong_ctrl &&
1192             !test_bit(XPT_CONG_CTRL, &rqstp->rq_xprt->xpt_flags))
1193                 goto err_bad_vers;

Fixes: 5283b03ee5 ("nfs/nfsd/sunrpc: enforce transport...")
Signed-off-by: Kinglong Mee <kinglongmee@gmail.com>
Reviewed-by: Jeff Layton <jlayton@redhat.com>
Signed-off-by: J. Bruce Fields <bfields@redhat.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug occurs because the backchannel transport (`xprt`) for NFSv4.1 is created without the `XPT_CONG_CTRL` flag being set. This omission leads to requests being rejected in the `svc_process_common()` function when congestion control is required, as the function checks for this flag before processing requests. Without the flag, the system cannot properly manage congestion, resulting in failed request handling.

Here is the patch:
  */
 static struct svc_xprt *svc_bc_create_socket(struct svc_serv *serv,
 					     int protocol,
 					     struct net *net,
 					     struct sockaddr *sin, int len,
 					     int flags)
 {
 	struct svc_sock *svsk;
 	struct svc_xprt *xprt;
 
 	if (protocol != IPPROTO_TCP) {
 		printk(KERN_WARNING "svc: only TCP sockets"
 			" supported on shared back channel\n");
 		return ERR_PTR(-EINVAL);
 	}
 
 	svsk = kzalloc(sizeof(*svsk), GFP_KERNEL);
 	if (!svsk)
 		return ERR_PTR(-ENOMEM);
 
 	xprt = &svsk->sk_xprt;
 	svc_xprt_init(net, &svc_tcp_bc_class, xprt, serv);
+	set_bit(XPT_CONG_CTRL, &svsk->sk_xprt.xpt_flags);
 
 	serv->sv_bc_xprt = xprt;
 
 	return xprt;
 }
